selection.rule: Complete same-request cycles inside warm; current layer index >= 1 and next layer index < n_layers-1; strictly positive exposed wait; minimize absolute distance to median wait, ties by request_id then current layer index.
selection.note: Median of the eligible positive-wait sample, not the mean wait of all short layers; layer indices in evidence are zero-based.

ratio_meaning: Exact accounting identity for this complete C+wait cycle and its fully received next-layer V; not an independent predictor or an instantaneous-utilization identity.
